simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹצֶן (H2684) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֹצֶן (chôtsen) means arm, lap. First listed occurrence: Isa 49 22.

definitions.full: H2684. chotsen חֹ֫צֶן noun masculine bosom ; — נָעַרְתִּי חָצְנִי Neh 5:13 I shook out my bosom (the bosom of my garment); בְּחֹ֫צֶן בָּנַיִךְ וְהֵבִיאוּ Isa 49:22 and they shall bring thy sons in the bosom (i.e. in the arms, clasped to the bosom, like infants; || עַלכָּֿתֵף ).
definitions.rootNote: a collateral form of 2683 , and meaning the same
